title: Comrades Marathon 2027 Entry Terms and Race Rules
claims: The Entry Terms govern entry into and participation in the 100th Comrades Marathon, scheduled for Sunday, 13 June 2027 as a Down Run from Pietermaritzburg to Durban over an approximate distance of 89 km, subject to final measurement and the Final Race Instructions.
The Race is organised by the Comrades Marathon Association (CMA).
The Race is not affiliated to Athletics South Africa or KwaZulu-Natal Athletics and is not represented as a World Athletics sanctioned event.
Required information must be submitted by 16h30 on 3 May 2027, failing which the entry will be forfeited.
Athletes must be at least 20 years old on the day of qualification.

The qualification window is 15 June 2026 to 3 May 2027; the qualifying event must be at least 42.2 km; only official published results are accepted, and Garmin, Strava or other personal-device records are not accepted.
The official risk list includes dehydration, heat or cold illness, cardiac events, collapse, musculoskeletal injury, traffic or crowd incidents, and death.

Unauthorised vehicles, mobile seconding or pacing, and carrying or physically supporting a runner are prohibited; stationary "stand and hand" assistance is permitted only to the extent stated in the final Race Rules.

A runner who misses a route or finish cut-off must immediately retire, leave the route as directed and use official withdrawal transport where instructed; the Final Race Instructions will confirm cut-off locations and times after the start format is approved.
